name: Onna Kyoushi Suzune ~Itoko to no Himitsu na Kankei~
original_name: 女教師・鈴音～イトコとの秘密な関係～
source:
Yuji's classroom teacher is his cousin, Suzune. He loves her, but he can't tell his love to her because they are relatives. One day, Suzune starts to live with Yuji's house for a week since her apartment is being remodeled. One night, she comes back to his house drunkenly, and pushes him over...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305063540/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1005893]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
雄二的班主任是他的表弟铃音。他爱她，但他不能向她表达他的爱，因为他们是亲戚。有一天，由于公寓正在装修，铃音开始在雄二家住了一个星期。一天晚上，她醉醺醺地回到他家，把他推倒了……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305063540/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1005893]Eroge Shop[/url]]
